Re:
Waiver requests for Diamond Estates -4" Filing
Dear Brad:
Thank you for your waiver request letters dated January 28 and February13,2013.1 have made the
following deter imi nations in accordance with the Cheyenne Unified Development Code:
1.It has generally been the policy of the Cityof Cheyenne Engineering Department to only change
cross-sections for residential streets at intersections as, absent extenuating circumstances,
having a variable width of right-of-way on a given block creates more problems than it solves.
The waiver request to continue the existing cross-section of Sapphire Street from the west edge
of Diamond Estates 4Filing to Pierce Avenue is approved.
2.In considering where Sapphire intersects with Pierce, it is important to consider not only the
spacing requirement from the Rio Verde/Green River intersection, but also possible future
subdivisions of Tracts317and318of Sunnyside Addition-7Filing.Were Sapphire tobe
spaced therequired200'from the Rio Verde/Green River intersection and then be extended to
the east, it would make 4117 Pierce and 4917-4933 Green River into double frontage lots,
which is undesirable.Alternatively, if Sunny Ridge Lane was extended west from Polk to
Pierce, it would bisect Tracts 317and318, continuing the redevelopment pattern of Sunnyside
Addition.Under this second scenario, it would be better for Sapphire tobe approximately
halfway between the extension of Sunny Ridge Lane and Rio Verde/Green River, which the
current submittal would accomplish. This waiver request is approved.
Please include this document with anyfuture permit or development applications relating toright-of-
way improvements at this site.If you have any questions or comments, please do not hesitate to
contact meat(307)638-4315orviaemail at nbeauheim@cheyenne city.org
Sincerely,
Nathan Beauheim, P.E.
Acting City Engineer
